description: This file is a C source code file implementing a firmware image builder for OpenWRT devices. It handles reading kernel and root filesystem images, constructing a firmware header, computing checksums, and writing the combined firmware image to a file.

methods.name: str2u32
methods.description: Converts a string to a uint32_t value, with error checking.

methods.name: get_file_stat
methods.description: Retrieves file size and updates file_info structure.

methods.name: read_to_buf
methods.description: Reads file contents into a buffer.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates command-line options and file parameters.

methods.name: write_fw
methods.description: Writes firmware data to output file.

methods.name: get_csum
methods.description: Calculates checksum over a data buffer.

methods.name: build_fw
methods.description: Builds the firmware image with header and payloads.
